description: Normalized header metadata of one task raster (orthophoto, DSM, DTM), read by the geospatial service when the raster becomes available. Arrays (geotransform, bounds) are stored as scalar columns so rows stay queryable and JSON columns never hold lists.

fields.description: Task field the raster came from: orthophoto, dsm or dtm.
fields.label: Dataset

fields.description: GDAL driver short name, e.g. GTiff.
fields.label: Driver
File Size (bytes)
fields.description: Long Int: orthophotos routinely exceed the 2 GiB an Int can hold.
NumPy-style data type of band 1, e.g. uint8, float32.
fields.label: Data Type

fields.description: Comma-separated per-band colour interpretation, e.g. red,green,blue,alpha.
fields.label: Color Interpretation

fields.description: Set when the raster has both a CRS and a real geotransform.
fields.label: Georeferenced

fields.description: Set when the raster has a non-identity geotransform (possibly without a CRS).
fields.label: Has Geotransform

fields.description: EPSG code of the raster CRS; 0 when unknown (see CRS WKT).
fields.label: EPSG

fields.description: CRS linear unit (metre, degree, ...).
fields.label: CRS Units

fields.description: CRS as WKT, only when no EPSG code is available.
fields.label: CRS WKT

fields.description: Pixel width in CRS units (ground sample distance).
fields.label: Pixel Size X

fields.description: Geotransform: X of the top-left corner.
fields.label: Origin X

fields.description: Geotransform: Y of the top-left corner.
fields.label: Origin Y

fields.description: Geotransform row-rotation term (0 for north-up rasters).
fields.label: Rotation X

fields.description: Bounds in the raster CRS.
fields.label: Min X

fields.description: Bounds in EPSG:4326.
fields.label: Lon Min

fields.description: NoData value as text ("-9999", "255", "nan"); empty when the raster declares none. Text because Float cannot store null or NaN.
fields.label: NoData

fields.description: Internal block (tile or strip) width in pixels.
fields.label: Block Width

fields.description: Compression method (deflate, lzw, jpeg, ...); empty when uncompressed.
fields.label: Compression

fields.description: Comma-separated overview decimation factors, e.g. 2,4,8,16.
fields.label: Overview Levels

fields.description: Validated as a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF.
fields.label: COG

fields.description: Why extraction failed; the other columns are empty when set.
fields.label: Error

name: WebODM Raster Metadata
